# About Heeyaku Technologies (Agartala, Tripura, India)
Heeyaku is an enterprise-grade EdTech infrastructure provider engineered specifically for high-growth education providers, coaching centers, and digital academies.

## Product Specifications & Capabilities:

### 1. Customer CRM Engine
- Ingestion speed: < 0.04ms decryption & round-robin routing
- Supported Ad Channels: Meta Leads API, Google Ads Webhooks, Shiksha, Collegedunia, Custom Web Forms
- Telemetry: Real-time counselor call logging, SLA breach alerts, and automated call recording sync

### 2. DRM Learning Platform (LMS)
- DRM Compliance: Widevine L1 & FairPlay streaming pipeline
- Anti-Piracy: On-screen dynamic student roll number & phone number watermark overlay
- Features: Live classes, recorded video vault, automated batch locking, online quiz engine, certificate generation

### 3. Edge Web Portals & Custom Website Development
- Performance: 100/100 Google Lighthouse mobile score
- Security: SSL/TLS 1.3 encryption, ISO 27001 data protection
- Payment Gateways: Razorpay, Cashfree, Stripe, UPI split EMI disbursement

### 4. Autonomous AI Automations
- WhatsApp Cloud API integration for instant drip messages
- Automated fee payment reminder bots with UPI deep links
- Google Calendar & Zoom mentor scheduling sync
